title: Bean Sprout Watch
shareTitle: Bean Sprout Watch — A Five-Day Growing Journal
description: Care for one little bean, draw each new root and leaf, and watch it grow through a five-day watercolor science journal.
learningGoals: Observe how a bean changes from seed to root, shoot, and young plant
Connect plant growth with water and sunlight
Practice attending to and drawing one new plant structure at a time
interactionModel: choose the current journal day, tap large water and sunshine tools in either order, then make a forgiving finger trace over one or two new root, stem, or leaf guides
feedbackModel: Care actions receive immediate gentle sound and visible used states; a meaningful trace blooms into the next authored watercolor plant stage, saves the journal day, and earns a Nature Explorer badge without scores, timers, or failure states.

modes.title: Five-Day Sprout Journal
modes.skill: observe plant growth as an ordered sequence of visible changes
